plainLanguage: Section 77 — Making proclamation for rioters to disperse — ni sehemu ya mfumo wa Chapter IX unaohusu unlawful assemblies, riots na public tranquility.
meaning: Provision authorises specified officials, where twelve or more persons are riotously assembled or a riot by twelve or more is apprehended within view, to make a proclamation in the President's name commanding peaceful dispersal.
keyPoints: Threshold stated is twelve or more persons.
Only the officials specified by the section may make/cause the proclamation.
The command is to disperse peacefully.

history.summary: Section 77 appears in Chapter IX of The Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Text verified against the R.E. 2022 government-hosted Penal Code.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Each statutory threshold and sequence should be proved from evidence.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Requirements such as reasonable time, authorised actors and reasonable necessity materially limit the provision's operation.

debateQuestion: Je, statutory conditions zote za section 77 zimetimizwa kwa facts husika?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
